release.content: pubrules 0.50.0 was released on 2026-11-25 from commit d224b533542652caf6c44aa77c2fa2214713507a with these changes.

rows: sync reads a prerelease pubtest in the lock (pubtestrules==0.5.0rc1) as no release, pinning the release state's or latest instead of 0.5.0, and a requirements-pubrules.txt template without exactly one '# pubtest floor: X.Y.Z' line stops pubrules with a message naming that line instead of a TypeError

pubrules service-needs asks for a live run (mode live) for a check or fulfil, prints 'Watch this run: PAGE' with the run's page, links the approval box there, and ends a run a person stopped with exit 1

actions/retry, actions/apt-install, actions/terraform-init and actions/pr-label are now pubactions' (Sustenaut/pubactions v0.1.0): pubrules' workflows use them at pubactions' release commit, and a caller pins Sustenaut/pubactions/actions/<name>@<commit> in place of Sustenaut/pubrules/actions/<name>; pubrules keeps actions/cache. job-service-terraform.yml and service-ci.yml read pubrules.json's mirror.terraform and give it to terraform-init as its mirror input, as before
